text:
maria: heads-up — deploy-bot flagged release/rc-20260320: p95 latency spike >2s and suggested auto-revert. holding here for ops + eng decision. @sam_ops @jeff

deploy-bot: ALERT: p95(5m)=2.3s > threshold(2.0s). Suggested action: auto-revert. Auto-revert will be executed unless manually suppressed. To suppress: `/deploy suppress-auto-revert --id rc-20260320`

sam_ops: looking at traces now. spike concentrated on encoder kernels in us-west-2. kvcache miss rate up and sustained queue depth on the infer nodes.

jeff: if we auto-revert, what's the blast radius? some partners use long-lived streams — could cause reconnects. need to weigh impact.

emma_prod: partners impact looks low-volume. a couple of dedicated streams (acct 12345) may see transient disconnects. prefer canary rollback (traffic-slice -> 20%) vs full revert.

maria: proposal: manual partial rollback — pin old model v2.4.1 for 20% traffic in us-west-2, hold 15m and observe. If p95 normalizes, step to 50% then full. release-note blurb: 'temporary rollback to mitigate latency regression — monitoring ongoing'.

sam_ops: agree. I'll run the split and watch metrics. command I'm going to use: ```redwoodctl rollout traffic-split --release rc-20260320 --region us-west-2 --split '{"v2.4.1":0.2,"rc-20260320":0.8}'```

deploy-bot: ACTION LOG: manual-suppressed-auto-revert by maria at 4077654325. Next: traffic-split job queued (job id 8902).

jeff: maria can you draft the short customer note? I'll ping SRE oncall.

maria: draft note: 'We observed a latency regression in today's release affecting some requests. We're temporarily routing 20% of traffic to the prior model while we investigate. No data loss expected.' Thoughts?

emma_prod: :thumbsup: send after job completes. add incident link: https://status.example.com/incidents/rc-20260320

sam_ops: traffic split applied — job 8902 succeeded. p95 dropping from 2.3s -> 1.1s within ~3m for the canary slice. continuing to monitor.

jeff: great. hold for 15m then if stable escalate to 50%. any objections?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rollout update: job 8921 -> increase v2.4.1 to 50% at 4077655225 if no regression flags.

maria: no objections. I'll post the release-note blurb and send the customer note once 50% confirmed stable.

sam_ops: FYI logs show a noisy kernel path for long-context sequences; filing tracing ticket INF-1429 to get more detail.

jeff: postmortem TODO: capture perf regression, add KVM hit rate into canary checks and consider adding a p95 guard for long contexts.

emma_prod: customer note sent to partners (cc: legal). will close loop when we ramp back.

deploy-bot: NOTE: auto-revert will remain disabled for rc-20260320 until a manual-clear tag is issued. To re-enable auto-reverts: `/deploy clear-manual-hold rc-20260320`
